description: Check a domain in one call: registration via RDAP (registered or likely available, registrar, created and expiry dates, status, nameservers; DNS fallback for TLDs without RDAP), DNS (A, NS, MX, CAA, DNSSEC) and email security (SPF, DMARC policy, DKIM on common selectors) with a 0 to 100 score, grade and findings. Params: domain (required). Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"domain":"github.com"}.
